entry.title: Project memory and learning
entry.why: Keep useful project memory and optional analysis-ready records.
entry.status: Authored starter; includes a JSON ledger and tested format adapter. No memory service or Decision-PGA installation is included.

briefing.purpose: Keep useful project memory and optional analysis-ready records.
briefing.inputs: Current decisions, observations, lessons and an agreed storage location.
briefing.approach: Capture concise typed records, retrieve relevant lessons and preserve comparable analysis slices.
briefing.outputs: Portable memory notes/JSON ledger and optional validated analysis export.
briefing.requirements: Local files; Python for the included validator/exporter.
briefing.limits: No memory service is included; never manufacture numeric evidence from prose or combine incomparable populations.
briefing.review_scope: Authored orientation to the linked guide/catalog; source-specific dates and limits remain in the source.

use_cases.title: Check a saved project ledger
use_cases.outcome: Format and reference checks on real records; no claim that recorded lessons are true or effective.

links.why: The role supplies capture and retrieval habits; this resource supplies the portable files and validator.
